name: 3x3 EYES ~Sanjiyan Henjou~
source:
3x3 Eyes ~Sanjiyan Henjou~ is based on the manga and anime series 3x3 Eyes. Pai, a young girl from the immortal tribe of sanzhiyan, three-eyed demons of Chinese origin, wants to become a human again. She meets a Japanese teenager named Yakumo Fujii, whom she accidentally turns into a "wu", an immortal obedient servant of a three-eyed demon. Together, Pai and Yakumo try to regain their lost humanity.

This game can be considered a side-story to the series. The player does not control Yakumo, but an ordinary high-school student named Kenichi Yamamoto. Accidentally, Kenichi comes into contact with the world of demons, and now he needs the help of Pai and Yakumo to be freed.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/3x3-eyes-sanjiyan-henj]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《3×3 EYES～三只眼变成～》改编自漫画及动画系列《3×3 EYES》。三眼族少女佩是一名源自中国的三眼妖怪，她希望重新变成人类。她遇见日本少年藤井八云，并意外将他变成了“无”——三眼妖怪不死且忠诚的仆从。佩与八云携手踏上找回人性的旅程。

本作可视为该系列的外传。玩家并不操控八云，而是扮演普通高中生山本健一。健一偶然接触到妖怪的世界，如今必须借助佩与八云的力量才能脱身。

[摘自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/3x3-eyes-sanjiyan-henj]Moby Games[/url]]
